summary: The attempt a review gate belongs to (cinatra#4762). ONE additive nullable column: artifact_review_gates.run_generation integer, the run's reset_generation when the gate was raised, read from the run row in the insert while the run executes (running or pending_approval), else -1. A publish gate counts only the reviews raised in the attempt that reached it, so a review of an attempt a retry's reset ended never counts. null = a gate raised before the column existed, read as generation 0. And ONE additive nullable column artifact_produced_outbox.producer_run_generation integer: the producing run's reset_generation when the event was written (read from the run row in the insert while it executes, else -1); the automatic review the delayed drain raises carries it, never the run's state at drain time; null = an event written before the column existed, whose review is stamped -1 and never counts. No backfill, no default, no constraint change: every existing row reads NULL. up runs outside a transaction with lock_timeout 5 s (set first, reset last), so an ALTER queued behind a long reader fails (55P03) and replays instead of stalling the table; the add itself is catalog-only. Idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL (the gate-store extension lines in src/lib/artifacts/artifact-review-gate-schema.ts), shipped in the SAME change. down() drops both columns and the generations they hold. SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: 0133 is the highest sequence on main (2026-11-23); a rename-only renumber at merge is normal.
